description: Read-only Linux host evidence collection for authorized incident response. Stores Run Command output in S3 and creates a SHA-256 integrity manifest.

AutomationAssumeRole.description: ARN of the IAM role that Systems Manager Automation assumes for preflight, command execution, and manifest creation.

InstanceId.description: Authorized EC2 instance ID to investigate.

IncidentId.description: Incident correlation identifier used in evidence prefixes and manifests.

EvidenceBucket.description: S3 bucket receiving Run Command stdout/stderr and the integrity manifest.

EvidencePrefix.description: Top-level S3 prefix. Keep it free of secrets and customer data.

commands:
set -u
export LC_ALL=C
section() { printf '\n===== %s =====\n' "$1"; }
run_if() {
  command_name="$1"; shift
  if command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    "$@" 2>&1 || printf '[command failed rc=%s] %s\n' "$?" "$*"
  else
    printf '[not installed] %s\n' "$command_name"
  fi
}

section "collection_header"
printf 'collection_time_utc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
printf 'instance_id=%s\n' "{{InstanceId}}"
printf 'incident_id=%s\n' "{{IncidentId}}"
printf 'automation_execution_id=%s\n' "{{automation:EXECUTION_ID}}"
printf 'hostname=%s\n' "$(hostname 2>/dev/null || true)"

section "operating_system"
uname -a 2>&1 || true
[ -r /etc/os-release ] && cat /etc/os-release || true
run_if hostnamectl hostnamectl
run_if uptime uptime

section "processes"
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,group,stat,lstart,etime,comm,args --ww 2>&1 || true

section "network_addresses_routes"
run_if ip ip addr show
run_if ip ip route show table all
run_if ss ss -plant
run_if lsof lsof -nP -i

section "services"
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-pager 2>&1 || true
  systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager 2>&1 || true
else
  run_if service service --status-all
fi

section "packages"
if command -v rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}\t%{INSTALLTIME:date}\n' 2>&1 | sort || true
elif command -v dpkg-query >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\t${Version}\t${Architecture}\n' 2>&1 | sort || true
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk info -vv 2>&1 | sort || true
else
  printf '[no supported package inventory command found]\n'
fi

section "users_and_logons"
getent passwd 2>&1 || true
run_if who who -a
run_if w w
run_if last last -a -n 100
run_if lastlog lastlog

section "scheduled_tasks"
[ -r /etc/crontab ] && cat /etc/crontab || true
for d in /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    printf -- '--- %s ---\n' "$d"
    find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%M %u %g %TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
  fi
done
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager 2>&1 || true
fi
if command -v crontab >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd 2>/dev/null | while read -r user; do
    output="$(crontab -u "$user" -l 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$output" ]; then
      printf -- '--- crontab user=%s ---\n%s\n' "$user" "$output"
    fi
  done
fi

section "kernel_mounts_modules"
run_if mount mount
run_if df df -hT
run_if lsmod lsmod

section "recent_file_metadata"
for d in /tmp /var/tmp; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  find "$d" -xdev -maxdepth 2 -type f -mtime -2 -printf '%M %u %g %s %TY-%Tm-%TdT%TH:%TM:%TS %p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -n 2000 || true
done

section "selected_logs"
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  journalctl --since '-24 hours' --no-pager -n 2500 2>&1 || true
fi
for f in /var/log/auth.log /var/log/secure /var/log/messages /var/log/syslog; do
  if [ -r "$f" ]; then
    printf -- '--- tail %s ---\n' "$f"
    tail -n 1000 "$f" 2>&1 || true
  fi
done

section "collection_footer"
printf 'collection_end_utc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

inputs.Script:
def build_manifest(events, context):
    import boto3
    import hashlib
    import json
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    bucket = events["bucket"]
    prefix = events["prefix"].rstrip("/") + "/"
    s3 = boto3.client("s3")

    paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    objects = []
    for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=bucket, Prefix=prefix):
        for item in page.get("Contents", []):
            key = item["Key"]
            if key.endswith("/integrity-manifest.json"):
                continue
            response = s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            body = response["Body"]
            while True:
                chunk = body.read(1024 * 1024)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                digest.update(chunk)
            objects.append({
                "key": key,
                "size": int(response.get("ContentLength", item.get("Size", 0))),
                "etag": str(response.get("ETag", "")).strip('"'),
                "version_id": response.get("VersionId", ""),
                "last_modified": response.get("LastModified", item.get("LastModified")).isoformat(),
                "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
            })

    objects.sort(key=lambda value: value["key"])
    canonical_index = json.dumps(objects, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    manifest = {
        "schema": "aws-ir-evidence-manifest/v1",
        "incident_id": events["incident_id"],
        "instance_id": events["instance_id"],
        "platform": events["platform"],
        "automation_execution_id": events["execution_id"],
        "run_command_id": events["command_id"],
        "collection_completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "s3_bucket": bucket,
        "s3_prefix": prefix,
        "evidence_object_count": len(objects),
        "evidence_index_sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical_index).hexdigest(),
        "objects": objects,
    }
    manifest_key = prefix + "integrity-manifest.json"
    s3.put_object(
        Bucket=bucket,
        Key=manifest_key,
        Body=(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\\n").encode("utf-8"),
        ContentType="application/json",
    )
    return {
        "manifest_uri": f"s3://{bucket}/{manifest_key}",
        "object_count": str(len(objects)),
        "evidence_index_sha256": manifest["evidence_index_sha256"],
    }
